rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Beachland Tavern. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Beachland has a full kitchen with homemade, locally sourced food and an affordable beer selection. The patio is open during Tavern shows in the evening.
concessions.quote: a full kitchen featuring homemade and locally sourced menu items, an extensive and affordable beer selection

accessibility.summary: To request an accommodation for a show or visit, email marketing@beachlandballroom.com or call 216.383.1124, Monday through Friday 11am to 5pm.
accessibility.quote: need assistance, or would like to request an accommodation for a show or visit

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online, by phone at 216-383-1124 weekdays 11am to 5pm, or in person at the venue's side door (ring the bell) weekdays 11am to 5pm, with no fees for cash. This Way Out, the shop in the building, also sells tickets and is open during most evening shows. Guests under 21 pay an extra fee at the door, and all purchases are non-refundable.
ticketPickup.quote: Go to side door at Beachland, ring bell, Monday – Friday, 11am – 5pm
